messages:
maria.k: quick idea — instead of whole-GPU reserved slices, can we try fractional dedicated slices (eg 0.25/0.5 GPU equivalents) for low-traffic tenants and credit egress/burst separately? could cut idle in reserved pools by ~20% on paper.
keenan: how would isolation work? noisy neighbor risk still concerns me.
maria.k: plan is: pack only latency-tolerant jobs (batch + embeddings) and keep strict network + nvlink qdisc; plus KV prefix caching pinned per-tenant. egress credits get used first before touching reserved quota.
jay.t: this feels like soft-dedicated with stronger guardrails. need hard preemption rules and a visible accounting meter.
nishant: agree on preemption. also: GPU mmap/allocator needs to enforce per-slice memory caps. otherwise one tenant can OOM the slice.
maria.k: yes — allocator changes are minimal: enforce vcpu-like mem/cuda allocation limits, and fail fast with a distinct error so runtime can fallback to hosted.
olivia: do we have telemetry to measure "micro-snr" (small noisy neighbor bursts) at 0.25 GPU granularity?
keenan: not today, we sample at slot level. we'd need to add slice-level aggregates and a few new labels (slice_fraction, is_reserved_fractional). ops-bot: metric-collector: created metric 'gpu.slice_utilization' in staging (tags: slice_fraction).
jay.t: how do we price/credit customers? fractional reservations complicate billing. egress-credit first sounds reasonable but we must avoid double-dipping.
maria.k: billing proposal: commit = fraction * base_reserved_rate, egress bursts billed via credits at a discounted reserved rate until credit depleted; overflow to on-demand. will loop in billing.
nishant: can we get a config snippet for the runtime? something like:
```
reserved_slices:
  - fraction: 0.25
    allowed_workloads: [embeddings, batch-generate]
    preempt_policy: immediate_fallback
    network_qdisc: strict
```
maria.k: exactly that. also want a canary where we only enable on racks with <65% baseline utilization.
keenan: ops question: AZ constraints — we can't mix fractional slices across AZs for a single tenant, right? that will break affinity.
maria.k: correct — keep fractional pins AZ-local. cross-AZ failover still uses full-reserved fallback.
jay.t: any impact on KV cache hotness? packing more tenants increases prefix thrash.
maria.k: we will pin hot prefixes for reserved tenants; fractional-pack gets the cold prefixes. need a cache admission policy.
olivia: :thumbsup: if we do this only for a small cohort first. also want error classification so we can detect "fractional preempt storms".
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out fractional-slices feature flag to staging at 2026-03-10T12:23:00Z.
keenan: great. next steps: 1) add slice-level telemetry 2) allocator memory caps + error surface 3) scheduler preempt rules 4) small canary in eu-west1 5) confirm billing flow with finance.
maria.k: I'll own 1-3, canary + metrics on eu-west1. jay, can you pick up billing convo?
jay.t: on it — will sync with finance and product.
nishant: I'll prototype allocator changes this week, ping me if you want perf test harness.
olivia: I'll prepare an alert playbook for fractional preempt storms.
maria.k: awesome. if no objections I'll open a RFC and a tiny runbook.
keenan: +1
jay.t: +1
ops-bot: reminder: please tag follow-ups with #frac-slices in the issue tracker.
